title: Saxe-Meiningen
capsule: Saxe-Meiningen (Sachsen-Meiningen) was one of the Ernestine Saxon duchies in Thuringia, ruled by the Wettin line from Meiningen. Between 1820 and 1866 Duke Bernhard II Erich Freund pursued a relatively liberal constitutional course, and the court became a European cultural center under Georg II (r. 1866–1914), whose Meiningen Theatre troupe achieved continent-wide acclaim. The duchy joined the North German Confederation after Prussia's victory in the Austro-Prussian War of 1866 and was incorporated into the German Empire at its proclamation on 18 January 1871.
